blocks.text: LONDON, United Kingdom — A British monarch has made only one state visit to China: Queen Elizabeth II’s trip four decades ago. King Charles III would consider making a second visit, according to a palace aide. “If the government said, ‘Will the king go to China?’ I think, you know, we would think about it very carefully,” a senior palace aide told reporters this week. The late queen, Charles’ mother, visited China with her husband, Prince Philip, in October 1986. The trip included stops in Beijing, Shanghai and Guangzhou, according to reports at the time.
